bibl.title: Imprisonment, Guarantors, and Release on Bail in the Ptolemaic Fayum.
bibl.seg: Brian Muhs, Imprisonment, Guarantors, and Release on Bail in the Ptolemaic Fayum.

Marie-Pierre Chaufray, Ivan Guermeur, Sandra Lippert & Vincent Rondot, Le Fayoum. Archéologie - Histoire - Religion. Actes du sixième colloque international, Montpellier, 26-28 octobre 2016 (Wiesbaden, 2018) pp. 89-99.
bibl.note: Examines an unpublished group of Demotic, Greek and bilingual ostraca dating to the late 3rd or early 2nd century BCE [in the collections of the University of Michigan at Ann Arbor and of the University of Copenhagen]. - The Acquisition of the Imprisonment Ostraca. - The Provenance of the Imprisonment Ostraca [Philadelphia]. - Previous Work on the Imprisonment Ostraca. - Demotic Texts. - 'Imprisonment', 'Brought' and 'Given to the Hand'. - 'Released'. - 'Ordered', 'Fled' and 'Brought'. - Greek Texts. - The Administration of Imprisonment. - Other Uses of Guarantors and Sureties. - Conclusions.
